scenario.title: Battle of Vitsi
intro.text:
BATTLE OF VITSI - 9 SEP 1948

South of Lake Kastoria, West Macedonia

Our last operation in the Grammos mountains was a bust! Most rebels escaped in the Vitsi region. Our job is now to prevent a renewed Redoubt in the Vitsi mountains and to destroy the escaped enemy forces. We plan a coordinated attack from the south and east to encircle the rebels. Your troops will lead the attack from the south and clean the area around the Lake Kastoria!

GOAL Capture all VH!

NOTE The unit occupying the town Dendrochori gets full replacements!
player.speaker: Commander
line.reaction-18-0-briliant.speaker: Thrasyvoulos Tsakalotos
line.reaction-18-0-briliant.text: Konitsa held. The DSE will not proclaim its capital there. The garrison needs replacements now; I don't want that request lost under the congratulations.
line.reaction-18-1-victory-tactical.text: The town remains under government control, though the surrounding villages changed hands and families crossed the lines in both directions.
line.callback-0.speaker: Thrasyvoulos Tsakalotos
line.callback-0.text: Konitsa held from inside the town. Headquarters wants to use that defence elsewhere. Before it does, I want an account of what happened to the civilians around the batteries.
line.callback-1.speaker: Petros Manesis
line.callback-1.text: We kept much of the Konitsa fighting outside the town. Staff college asked for the map. I sent the evacuation routes with it; someone had left them off the copy.
line.earned-decision.speaker: Thrasyvoulos Tsakalotos
line.earned-decision.text: The Konitsa patrols have arrived with their guides, radios, and most of their fuel. The line battalions have arrived with requests for all three.
line.earned-decision.choice.keep-konitsa: Keep the Konitsa scouts as a separate reconnaissance troop.
Add an experienced seven-strength reconnaissance cavalry detachment.
line.earned-decision.choice.return-konit: Distribute the patrols' veterans and fuel through the core.
Give infantry 10 experience and fully refuel the core.
line.earned-a-response.speaker: Thrasyvoulos Tsakalotos
line.earned-a-response.text: Keep the troop. A guide who knows his sergeant reports more than a guide passed from headquarters to headquarters.
line.earned-b-response.speaker: Dimitris Laskaris
line.earned-b-response.text: Send the guides to battalion staffs, the vehicles to the worn companies and the fuel to the main column. Have the troop commander make the assignments with them.
line.scene-0.speaker: Petros Manesis
line.scene-0.text: The intelligence annex marks a shepherd's path in red. The shepherd who drew it has already moved his family twice, and now three captains want him as their guide.
line.scene-1.speaker: Thrasyvoulos Tsakalotos
line.scene-1.text: The government wants the four towns. The DSE can leave them by these paths while we bring the guns up. We need to decide whether we're after the garrisons or the squares.
line.scene-2.speaker: Dimitris Laskaris
line.scene-2.text: Take the towns first and we show control. Close the routes first and the towns have time to prepare—and to learn which villagers spoke to us.
line.decision.speaker: Dimitris Laskaris
line.decision.text: Where does the main weight go: Kastoria and Dendrochori, or the smaller routes through Korisos and Dispilio?
line.decision.choice.take-the-towns-firs: Mass the guns and take Kastoria and Dendrochori first.
Give infantry and artillery 15 experience and fully rearm the core.
line.decision.choice.close-the-mountain-: Send reconnaissance groups through Korisos and Dispilio before the main assault.
Give reconnaissance 20 experience and fully refuel and rearm the core.
line.choice-a-0.speaker: Petros Manesis
line.choice-a-0.text: The red paths stay open, then. Do not call the guides cowards when they vanish; we have painted targets on their houses by listening to them.
line.choice-a-1.speaker: Thrasyvoulos Tsakalotos
line.choice-a-1.text: The guns go on the towns. Once they fall, columns turn outward without waiting for ceremony in the squares.
line.choice-b-0.speaker: Thrasyvoulos Tsakalotos
line.choice-b-0.text: Small groups in those villages can become occupation parties before they notice. Searches require officers, and guides are not to be paraded through the streets.
line.choice-b-1.speaker: Petros Manesis
line.choice-b-1.text: I'll brief them myself. Korisos and Dispilio first; the main force moves when the paths stop carrying DSE supplies.
